blueprints.description: Work orders for a maintenance or field-service team: a work order list, a work order page with its tasks, parts and time, a board by step and a schedule of visits.

screens.name: workorders.list
screens.title: Work orders
screens.description: Every work order with its site, priority, assignee and status.

screens.name: workorders.record
screens.title: Work order
screens.description: One work order: key facts, its tasks, the parts used, the time logged and its activity.

screens.name: workorders.board
screens.title: Board
screens.description: Work orders in a column for each step: new, scheduled, in progress and done.

screens.name: workorders.schedule
screens.title: Schedule
screens.description: The day each work order is planned, on a calendar.

templates.name: WorkOrdersList
templates.description: Every work order with its site, priority, assignee, due date and status, filtered by status, priority, site and assignee.

templates.name: WorkOrderPage
templates.description: One work order: status, priority, days to its due date and hours logged, its details, tasks, parts and time, and its activity.

templates.name: WorkOrdersBoard
templates.description: Work orders as cards in a column for each step, moved by dragging or by menu.

templates.name: WorkOrdersSchedule
templates.description: The day of each planned visit, on a month, a week or as an agenda, with the status told in words.

templates.name: WorkOrdersQuickCreateWorkOrder
templates.displayName: Work orders quick create work order
templates.description: A short form that creates one work order without leaving the page.
